description: This file defines a class that adds rel="noopener" to HTML links with a target attribute, for security purposes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrTransform_TargetNoopener
classes.description: A class that modifies HTML attributes to add rel="noopener" to links targeting new windows.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Modifies the 'rel' attribute of a link to include 'noopener' if it targets a different window.
